doc: A Bézout ring is a ring whose finitely generated ideals are principal.
statement: (R : Type u) → [Semiring R] → Prop
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], (∀ (I : Ideal R), I.FG → Submodule.IsPrincipal I) → IsBezout R

doc: Any finitely generated ideal is principal.
statement: ∀ {R : Type u} {inst : Semiring R} [self : IsBezout R] (I : Ideal R), I.FG → Submodule.IsPrincipal I

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (I : Ideal R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal I],
  Ideal.span {Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I} = I

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : Module R M] (S : Submodule R M)
  [inst_3 : S.IsPrincipal], Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator S ∈ S

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : Module R M] (S : Submodule R M)
  [inst_3 : S.IsPrincipal] {x : M}, x ∈ S ↔ ∃ s, x = s • Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator S

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : Module R M] (S : Submodule R M)
  [inst_3 : S.IsPrincipal], S = ⊥ ↔ Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator S = 0

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : Module R M],
  Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator ⊥ = 0

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : Semiring R] [inst_2 : Module R M] {S : Submodule R M},
  S.IsPrincipal → S.FG

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] [IsDomain R] (r : R),
  Associated (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (Ideal.span {r})) r

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] (S : Ideal R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal S] {x : R},
  x ∈ S ↔ Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator S ∣ x

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] (S : Ideal R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal S] [is_prime : S.IsPrime],
  S ≠ ⊥ → Prime (Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator S)

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : CommSemiring R] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {N O : Submodule R M} (hNO : N ≤ O) (ϕ : ↥O →ₗ[R] R) [inst_3 : (ϕ.submoduleImage N).IsPrincipal] {x : M} (hx : x ∈ N),
  Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (ϕ.submoduleImage N) ∣ ϕ ⟨x, ⋯⟩

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] {r : R} {s : Set R} [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span s)],
  r ∣ Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator (Ideal.span s) ↔ ∀ x ∈ s, r ∣ x

doc:
A choice of gcd of two elements in a Bézout domain.

Note that the choice is usually not unique.
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : Ring R] → (x y : R) → [Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})] → R

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Ring R] (x y : R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})],
  Ideal.span {IsBezout.gcd x y} = Ideal.span {x, y}
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (x y : R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})], IsBezout.gcd x y ∣ x
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (x y : R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})], IsBezout.gcd x y ∣ y

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {x y z : R} [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})],
  z ∣ x → z ∣ y → z ∣ IsBezout.gcd x y

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] (x y : R) [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})],
  ∃ a b, a * x + b * y = IsBezout.gcd x y
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {x y : R} [Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})], IsRelPrime x y → IsCoprime x y
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] {x y : R} [Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})], IsRelPrime x y ↔ IsCoprime x y

doc:
Any Bézout domain is a GCD domain. This is not an instance since `GCDMonoid` contains data,
and this might not be how we would like to construct it.
statement: (R : Type u) → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsBezout R] → [IsCancelMulZero R] → [DecidableEq R] → GCDMonoid R

∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommRing R] {x y : R} [inst_1 : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.span {x, y})]
  [inst_2 : GCDMonoid R], Associated (IsBezout.gcd x y) (gcd x y)

doc: A version of Bézout's lemma for greatest common divisors over arbitrary `Finset`s.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} {α : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [inst_2 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R] (s : Finset α)
  (f : α → R), ∃ g, s.gcd f = ∑ a ∈ s, f a * g a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {S : Ideal R} [hpi : S.IsPrime],
  S ≠ ⊥ → S.IsMaximal
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : EuclideanDomain R] {S : Ideal R} {x y : R}, y ∈ S → (x % y ∈ S ↔ x ∈ S)
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R], IsField R → IsPrincipalIdealRing R
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {p : R}, Irreducible p → Ideal.IsMaximal (R ∙ p)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [IsDomain R] {p : R},
  p ≠ 0 → (Irreducible p ↔ Ideal.IsMaximal (R ∙ p))

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] [IsDomain R],
  ¬IsField R → ∀ {p : R}, Irreducible p ↔ Ideal.IsMaximal (R ∙ p)

doc: `factors a` is a multiset of irreducible elements whose product is `a`, up to units
statement: {R : Type u} → [inst : CommRing R] → [IsDomain R] → [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] → R → Multiset R

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : IsPrincipalIdealRing R] (a : R),
  a ≠ 0 → (∀ b ∈ PrincipalIdealRing.factors a, Irreducible b) ∧ Associated (PrincipalIdealRing.factors a).prod a

∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {a b : R},
  a ≠ 0 → b ∈ PrincipalIdealRing.factors a → b ≠ 0

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : IsPrincipalIdealRing R] (s : Submonoid R) {a : R},
  a ≠ 0 → (∀ b ∈ PrincipalIdealRing.factors a, b ∈ s) → (∀ (c : Rˣ), ↑c ∈ s) → a ∈ s

doc:
If a `RingHom` maps all units and all factors of an element `a` into a submonoid `s`, then it
also maps `a` into that submonoid.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsDomain R] [inst_2 : IsPrincipalIdealRing R]
  [inst_3 : NonAssocSemiring S] (f : R →+* S) (s : Submonoid S) (a : R),
  a ≠ 0 → (∀ b ∈ PrincipalIdealRing.factors a, f b ∈ s) → (∀ (c : Rˣ), f ↑c ∈ s) → f a ∈ s

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N) {S : Submodule R M},
  S.IsPrincipal → (Submodule.map f S).IsPrincipal

∀ {R : Type u} {M : Type v} {N : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_3 : Module R M] [inst_4 : Module R N] (f : M →ₗ[R] N),
  Function.Surjective ⇑f → ∀ (S : Submodule R N) [hI : (Submodule.comap f S).IsPrincipal], S.IsPrincipal

∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type u_1} {F : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : FunLike F R S]
  [RingHomClass F R S] (f : F) {I : Ideal R}, Submodule.IsPrincipal I → Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.map f I)

∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type u_1} {F : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : FunLike F R S]
  [inst_3 : RingHomClass F R S] (f : F),
  Function.Surjective ⇑f → ∀ (I : Ideal S) [hI : Submodule.IsPrincipal (Ideal.comap f I)], Submodule.IsPrincipal I

doc: The surjective image of a principal ideal ring is again a principal ideal ring.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type u_1} {F : Type u_3} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S] [inst_2 : FunLike F R S]
  [RingHomClass F R S] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] (f : F), Function.Surjective ⇑f → IsPrincipalIdealRing S

∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring S],
  IsPrincipalIdealRing (R × S) ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing R ∧ IsPrincipalIdealRing S

∀ {ι : Type u_5} [Finite ι] {R : ι → Type u_4} [inst : (i : ι) → Semiring (R i)],
  IsPrincipalIdealRing ((i : ι) → R i) ↔ ∀ (i : ι), IsPrincipalIdealRing (R i)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] (x y : R),
  ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0) → (∀ z ∈ nonunits R, z ≠ 0 → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) → IsCoprime x y
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] (x y : R), Irreducible x → x ∣ y ∨ IsCoprime x y
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] {p n : R}, Irreducible p → (IsCoprime p n ↔ ¬p ∣ n)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] {p n : R}, Irreducible p → (p ∣ n ↔ ¬IsCoprime p n)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] {p a : R} (m : ℕ), Irreducible p → ¬p ∣ a → IsCoprime a (p ^ m)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] {p : R}, Irreducible p → ∀ (i : R), IsCoprime p i ∨ p ∣ i

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (x y : R),
  Ideal.span {gcd x y} = Ideal.span {IsBezout.gcd x y}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (x y : R),
  Ideal.span {gcd x y} = Ideal.span {x, y}

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (a b : R) {z : R},
  gcd a b ∣ z ↔ ∃ x y, z = a * x + b * y

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (a b : R),
  ∃ x y, gcd a b = a * x + b * y

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] [inst_3 : GCDMonoid R] (x y : R),
  IsUnit (gcd x y) ↔ IsCoprime x y
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] {p n : R}, Prime p → (IsCoprime p n ↔ ¬p ∣ n)

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] {a b c : R},
  IsCoprime a b → ∀ {k : ℕ}, a * b = c ^ k → ∃ d, Associated (d ^ k) a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsBezout R] [IsDomain R] {a b c : R},
  IsCoprime a b → ∀ {k : ℕ}, Associated (c ^ k) (a * b) → ∃ d, Associated (d ^ k) a

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {x y : R},
  ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0) → (∀ (z : R), Irreducible z → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) → IsCoprime x y

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] {x y : R},
  ¬(x = 0 ∧ y = 0) → (∀ (z : R), Prime z → z ∣ x → ¬z ∣ y) → IsCoprime x y

doc: `nonPrincipals R` is the set of all ideals of `R` that are not principal ideals.
statement: (R : Type u) → [inst : Semiring R] → Set (Ideal R)
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], Ideal.nonPrincipals R = ∅ ↔ IsPrincipalIdealRing R

doc:
Any chain in the set of non-principal ideals has an upper bound which is non-principal.
(Namely, the union of the chain is such an upper bound.)

If you want the existence of a maximal non-principal ideal see
`Ideal.exists_maximal_not_isPrincipal`.
statement:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R],
  ¬IsPrincipalIdealRing R →
    ∀ c ⊆ Ideal.nonPrincipals R, IsChain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) c → ∃ I ∈ Ideal.nonPrincipals R, ∀ J ∈ c, J ≤ I
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R], ¬IsPrincipalIdealRing R → ∃ I, Maximal (fun x => ¬Submodule.IsPrincipal x) I

∀ {R : Type u} [inst : EuclideanDomain R] [inst_1 : GCDMonoid R] (n m : R),
  Ideal.span {n} ⊓ Ideal.span {m} = Ideal.span {lcm n m}

∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : NormalizationMonoid R] (I : Ideal R) [Submodule.IsPrincipal I],
  ∃ x, normalize x = x ∧ I = Ideal.span {x}
